$comment: The single registry for the demos runtime — the spine both trees read. The Python backend (voqalize_demos.manifest) binds each name to a Brain and mounts /{name}/s/{id}. The frontend reads THIS FILE directly: vite.config.ts derives the MPA entrypoints, src/index/main.tsx renders the landing cards, and src/config.ts pulls each demo's stt/tts + wiring. The provisioning script creates one agent per entry with brain_url = wss://{host}/{name}. Adding a demo touches more than this file — follow the checklist in demos/README.md.
